note: Events about the minority investments (Chef Ready Foods, Kootenay Dehydrators, South Peace Dehy-Products), which the atlas does not draw. Each event's subject must be a record, so these are held here, in the atlas event shape. Their holdings are census rows.

events.title: Province holds 33.33 per cent of Chef Ready Foods Ltd., 10,000 common shares
events.interpretation_notes: A minority investment, not a subsidiary.

events.title: Chef Ready Foods investment provided for as doubtful ($85,000)

evidence.locator: Public Accounts 1979/80, printed B5 (PDF p. 173) and B8 (PDF p. 176)

events.interpretation_notes: A provision against the investment, not a sale of the shares or a dissolution.

events.title: Province holds 33.33 per cent of Kootenay Dehydrators’ 2,000 common shares and all 98,000 Class B common shares

evidence.locator: Public Accounts 1977/78, printed B5 (PDF p. 73); Auditor General 1978, para. 8C.25 (PDF p. 32)

events.interpretation_notes: The Auditor General adds that the Province had guaranteed its loans to $1,952,000, paid it interest reimbursement grants, and that officials doubted its viability.

events.title: Province’s interest in Kootenay Dehydrators printed as 35.9 per cent of 2,000 Class A common shares, plus all 98,000 Class B
events.interpretation_notes: The percentage differs from 1977/78 with no transaction shown; holding all of one class does not show voting control.

events.title: Province holds 27.7 per cent of South Peace Dehy-Products Ltd.: 277 non-voting common and 277 voting preferred shares
events.interpretation_notes: A minority investment, not a subsidiary.

events.title: South Peace Dehy-Products investment provided for as doubtful ($554)

evidence.locator: Public Accounts 1979/80, printed B5 (PDF p. 173) and B8 (PDF p. 176)
